name: Gens Aurea S.p.A.
summary: Gens Aurea S.p.A. engages in the buying and selling of gold and precious metals in European countries. The company operates in four segments: gold buying, jewelry, investment in gold, and buyback. It also trades, imports, and exports metals, stones, watches, and other precious objects; costume jewelry and ornaments, both new and used, at both wholesale and retail levels; as well as the trade in leather goods and articles made of leather, hide, and synthetic materials, boutique and gift items in general, perfumery articles for both personal and home use, cosmetic products, writing articles, clothing accessories, and textile products, and related or ancillary products.
